thread:
rachel_finance: AuroraHealth submitted a true-up dispute for INV-94022 — they say platform fees spiked because metering reported double usage during the cutover. Can someone pull the meter logs and contract rule?

tim_sales: I saw their ticket. They upgraded support mid-cycle which might have triggered a recalculation, but the customer insists the commit and tier stayed the same.

carl_custsuccess: Customer sent screenshots showing platform fee jumped from $9,600 to $28,800 for the month. They claim we billed flat + overage incorrectly. billing-bot: System note: Invoice INV-94022 lines: ["Committed GPU: $80,000", "Platform fee: $28,800", "Support (Enterprise): $8,000"], total_due: $116,800. Metering snapshot: 2026-03-01T00:00Z to 2026-03-31T23:59Z; reported_tokens: 1,200,000; billing_rule_applied: platform_flat_plus_overage.

rachel_finance: Does the contract have flat+overage clause? @sophia_legal can you check AMND-6222?

sophia_legal: Pulling AMND-6222. Clause 7.2 has "Platform Fee: base flat fee plus overage calculated on billable request units (BRU) exceeding committed threshold." However Schedule F defines thresholds but the Signed Schedule F uploaded shows threshold = 1,000,000 BRU; the metering indicates 1.2M so overage could apply.

tim_sales: Customer says their internal metering shows ~600k BRU. There's a mismatch between our meter and theirs. Carl, did we receive any telemetry handoff at cutover?

carl_custsuccess: We ingested a telemetry bundle from their on-prem agent on 03-02. Ops noted some duplicate ingestion events around 03-15 due to a retry bug in the collector. I filed a note to eng.

billing-bot: Metering debug snippet: 
```
raw_events = 1_500_000
dedup_window = 30s
dedup_applied = false  # dedup logic disabled due to collector flag
billable_units = aggregate_to_BRU(raw_events)
```

sophia_legal: If duplication is internal and not caused by customer, contract allows us to investigate and adjust. We should not bill overage until we validate.

rachel_finance: Action plan: 1) put INV-94022 on hold (Billing Dispute), 2) create provisional credit for disputed overage amount, 3) task eng to re-run dedup and provide corrected BRU, 4) get customer to confirm a reconciliation window.

carl_custsuccess: I told AuroraHealth we paused collection and asked for their telemetry export for cross-check. They sent it and their BRU is ~610k.

billing-bot: Provisional calc: 
```
commit_threshold = 1_000_000
our_reported = 1_200_000
customer_reported = 610_000
overage_units = our_reported - commit_threshold  # 200k
overage_rate_per_100k = 9600  # example
overage_charge = (overage_units/100_000) * overage_rate_per_100k  # ~19,200
```

tim_sales: Customer expects full reversal of the overage if our dedupe shows duplication. They'll sign an acknowledgement that corrected invoice closes the case.

sophia_legal: Legal note: credits > $10k require director approval. Also preserve chain of custody for telemetry files.

rachel_finance: I'll draft a provisional credit memo CM-9102 for $19,200 and route for approvals. Hold dunning until final.

carl_custsuccess: Eng responded: duplicate ingestion bug fixed, reprocessed ingestion with dedupe, new BRU = 605k. Eng attached reprocessed-metering.csv and flagged PR-3922.

billing-bot: Reprocessed results applied. Adjusted billable BRU = 605,000 -> below threshold. System updated Invoice INV-94022 to remove overage line. New invoice total: $97,600. Corrected invoice ID: INV-94022-R1.

sophia_legal: Approved CM-9102 reversal. Routing to director now for sign-off.

rachel_finance: Director approved credit. CM-9102 posted and INV-94022-R1 sent to customer. Update RevRec and AR ledger accordingly.

carl_custsuccess: AuroraHealth confirmed receipt and closed the dispute. They asked for a short postmortem on the collector bug and a waiver for billing impact during the next cutover.

tim_sales: I'll follow up on the waiver request; recommend a 30-day grace period on metering reconciliation for on-prem migrations.

sophia_legal: Legal okay with a documented 30-day reconciliation process if added to Schedule F amendment and countersigned. Sales to capture signature.

rachel_finance: Closing thread. Logged PR-3922, CM-9102, INV-94022-R1, and contract note for AMND-6222. Thanks team.
